import json, subprocess, sys, copy

PROG = '/app/submission/scheduler.py'
ERR = '{"error":"invalid input"}\n'


def run(raw):
    if isinstance(raw, str):
        raw = raw.encode()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', PROG], input=raw,
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=120)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr


res = []


def expect_invalid(raw, label):
    rc, out, err = run(raw)
    ok = (rc == 2 and out == ERR.encode())
    res.append((ok, label, rc, out[:200], err[:200]))


def expect_valid(req, label):
    rc, out, err = run(json.dumps(req))
    ok = rc == 0
    if ok:
        try:
            json.loads(out)
        except Exception:
            ok = False
    res.append((ok, label, rc, out[:200], err[:200]))
    if ok:

    return None
